payload.title: FUN-automations: public-process proof for Automations after vertical completion
currentProgress: CUT-AUTO-WORK (#1509), CLN-AUTO-FOLD-SERVICE (#1547), and DEL-AUTO (#1566 / 6b6fa9354) are Factory-terminal.
Live pkg/services/automations root directories are only wire/, internal/, and transports/ plus root contract/test files; service/ is gone and packaged_root_shape_test locks that shape.
Existing tests/functional/automations already cover cron, filesystem watcher, and hosted_sources root.BuildProcess inertness and lifecycle through edges.Edges.
FUN-automations is the mandatory public-process proof step that closes the Automations vertical track after CUT→fold→DEL.
payload.requestedOutcome: Prove Automations as a packaged service through public process composition only: root.BuildProcess, public Automations/Work protocol surfaces, and edges.Edges effect replacement. Extend or add focused functional proofs under tests/functional/automations (and owner-local root contract tests if needed) so cron, filesystem watchers, hosted sources, script pollers, and reconciliation remain inert until runtime lifecycle starts, then exercise public Automations admission/lifecycle without importing automations/internal, automations/wire implementation details from outside the owner, or deleted automations/service paths. Confirm no production peer reaches Automations through transitional packages. Do not fold or delete packages. Do not invent Automations HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters or reopen accepted CLI UX. Do not open PSS-I0* shared integrators. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.
changedPathLease: pkg/services/automations/** root contract/characterization tests only when required for public-process proof
exclude unrelated owner functional suites except shared support helpers required by BuildProcess
acceptanceCriteria: Functional proofs construct Automations only through root.BuildProcess and edges.Edges (behavioral)
Cron, filesystem watcher, and hosted-sources sidecars remain inert before runtime lifecycle and activate through public Automations surfaces after lifecycle (behavioral)
No new test or production imports of deleted automations/service or peer imports of automations/internal
Packaged Automations root shape remains wire/, internal/, transports/ plus thin root contracts
Typecheck, lint, and required CI are terminal green; PR merged before Factory completion
antiPatterns: Treating DEL-AUTO merge alone as FUN-automations complete without public-process proof
Reaching Automations through wire/internal from outside the owner in functional proofs
Inventing protocol adapters or reopening accepted CLI UX under a FUN lease
Folding or deleting Automations packages in this packet
Broad functional-test topology rewrites unrelated to Automations

payload.title: IMP-RUN-04: Runtime opaque checkpoint_recovery with process-local CheckpointStore
currentProgress: DEC-RUN-REC-DURABILITY is Factory-terminal and checked in under docs/temp/projects/packaged-service-structure/dec-run-rec-durability.md.

Decision authorizes IMP-RUN-04 now: Runtime owns opaque checkpoint capture/load/compatibility/restore; Recordings remains durable history authority; process-local/default CheckpointStore adapter is sufficient; Recordings-backed durable checkpoint bytes are follow-on.
CTR-RUN and CTR-REC remain Factory-terminal; ownership inventory already targets factory_runtime/internal/services/checkpoint_recovery.

CLN-RUN-FOLD-SERVICE is live on factory_runtime/service; this packet must lease only checkpoint_recovery (and existing top-level checkpointstore/checkpointsummary surfaces it consolidates) and must not fold service/ or engine/pipeline.
CUT-VIS-RUN is Factory-terminal; CUT-RUN-REC remains held while Runtime service/engine folds own implementation leases.
payload.requestedOutcome: Implement Runtime-owned opaque Checkpoint/Recovery as a private subservice under pkg/services/factory_runtime/internal/services/checkpoint_recovery (consolidating live top-level checkpointstore/checkpointsummary into that private layout when they are the transitional sources). Expose only opaque capture/load/compatibility/restore through Factory Runtime root contracts — no Petri/JavaScript internals and no CheckpointStore types on peer surfaces. Ship a process-local/default CheckpointStore adapter sufficient to prove compatible restore and corrupt-checkpoint handling. Do not implement Recordings-backed durable checkpoint byte storage. Do not create a top-level Checkpoint service. Do not fold or delete factory_runtime/service or engine/pipeline (owned by CLN-RUN-FOLD-*). Do not admit CUT-RUN-REC. Coordinate shared coverage/ownership/package-target churn with live Runtime folds via the PR merge loop. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.
changedPathLease: pkg/services/factory_runtime root contract surfaces required to expose opaque checkpoint recovery
pkg/services/factory_runtime/wire/** only if private subservice construction must register
docs/internal baselines/package-target/ownership rows for checkpoint_recovery paths only
exclude creating a top-level Checkpoint service
acceptanceCriteria: checkpoint_recovery lives under factory_runtime/internal/services/checkpoint_recovery (or INV-recorded private destination)
Peers interact only through Factory Runtime root contracts; no CheckpointStore types or Petri/JS internals leak (behavioral)
Process-local/default CheckpointStore adapter proves compatible restore and corrupt-checkpoint handling (behavioral)
No Recordings-backed durable checkpoint storage ships in this packet
No top-level Checkpoint service package is created
factory_runtime/service and engine/pipeline are not folded or deleted by this packet
Typecheck, lint, and required CI are terminal green; PR merged before Factory completion
antiPatterns: Waiting for Recordings durable-log completion before starting IMP-RUN-04
Making Runtime a second canonical event ledger
Exposing Petri/JS checkpoint internals on peer surfaces
Folding factory_runtime/service or engine/pipeline under the IMP-RUN-04 lease

payload.title: Meta-planner follow-up after FUN-automations and IMP-RUN-04
